accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
$VTRS closed at 17.8, a new annual closing high.
Highest weekly close in 5 years.
The 18.2 five-year high is now the line overhead.

queue.headline: $REX turned away at 44.5 again
queue.body: The pullback held 43.4, where the most shares have traded in recent months.

Jobless claims are averaging 11.1% below a year ago.
GDPNow has growth at 5% while median CPI runs 2.1%.
Growth is firming while inflation remains a bit warm.

queue.headline: $KMT reclaimed the August buyer base
queue.body: The most-traded price of the past six months held at 29.6. The close back above 30.7 puts the average price paid since the August volume spike underneath.

$BKR 56.5: bottom of the six-month high-volume range
$BKR 64.7: top of the same range
Below 56.5, $BKR leaves the range
$CMS printed a new 52-week low. Ugly.

queue.headline: $WING lost the line that mattered
queue.body: The close below 112 invalidates the trade.

queue.headline: 3 straight red closes have $EBAY back below 109
queue.body: That's where the most shares changed hands over the past six months. The market's busiest price is overhead again.

queue.headline: $WS rejected at 37 again
queue.body: The 5th rejection in a year leaves the ceiling intact.
$TTD just posted its lowest weekly close in 5 years.

queue.headline: $WBD just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 81% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 444 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.
